segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מְחַתְּכִין אֶת הַדִּלּוּעִין לִפְנֵי הַבְּהֵמָה, וְאֶת הַנְּבֵלָה לִפְנֵי הַכְּלָבִים. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אִם לֹא הָיְתָה נְבֵלָה מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, אֲסוּרָה — לְפִי שֶׁאֵינָהּ מִן הַמּוּכָן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One may cut the pumpkins before an animal» on Shabbat, as long as they were picked prior to Shabbat. «And» likewise one may cut «an» animal «carcass before the dogs» on Shabbat. «Rabbi Yehuda says: If it was not» already «a carcass,» i.e., it was not dead, «prior to Shabbat, it is prohibited» to cut it or even move it on Shabbat «because it is not prepared» for use on Shabbat.

moves.summary: One may cut pumpkins and a carcass before animals
Forbidden if it was not a carcass before Shabbat
moves.about: whether a carcass of an animal that died on Shabbat may be cut before dogs, or is muktzeh as not prepared

positions.claim: One may cut pumpkins before an animal and a carcass before dogs on Shabbat
A carcass that died on Shabbat is forbidden since it is not prepared
